post.summary: Send a password-reset email (same response whether or not the account exists)
Log in; returns an access token and sets the refresh-token cookie
Revoke the refresh token and clear its cookie
Rotate the refresh-token cookie and return a new access token

post.description: Always 202 for a valid request, even if the email is already registered (the owner is notified instead). 409 `username_taken` if the public username is in use.
post.summary: Create an account and send a verification email
Resend the verification email (same response whether or not the account exists)
Set a new password with the token from the reset email; ends all sessions
Confirm an email address with the token from the verification email
Start a new game (abandons the current in-progress game, if any)

patch.description: `search_tree` is optional: omit it to keep the saved tree, send `null` to clear it. Its `root_board` must keep the givens (422 `givens_modified`).
patch.summary: Autosave board, notes, timer and search tree (optimistic lock on `version`)

post.summary: Indices of wrong cells; each wrong cell counts as a mistake

post.description: Optionally include the final board (same shape as PATCH) to save and complete in one call. Any client-sent score is ignored; the score is computed on the server.
post.summary: Verify the solved board server-side and store the computed score
Next hint at stage 1 (technique + region), 2 (cells) or 3 (value)

post.description: Constraint-only (never compares with the solution). Every returned placement counts as an auto placement and costs `search_costs.auto_placement` points. Does not change `version`. 422 `givens_modified` if `board` changes a given.
post.summary: Search mode: direct implications (naked/hidden singles) of a node's board
